reason: The team already lives in Trello and Slack and it mostly works; my real problem is overrunning estimates, and nothing here says it fixes that. Asking everyone to move their boards and their chat at once is a bigger cost than $45 a month.
objection: Moving the whole team off Slack and Trello is a big ask, and if even one person keeps using Slack we end up with two places to check instead of one.
would_change_my_mind: If it imported our Trello boards and Slack history in one go and showed time or budget per client against the estimate, so it actually helps with the overruns.
